`aria-invalid` turns the edge and the focus ring red. Link the message with `aria-describedby` so it is announced, not just colored.
`onValueChange` hands you the string directly, so there’s no `event.target.value` to unwrap. `onChange` still works too.
`readOnly` keeps the value focusable, selectable and submitted, with a muted surface so it doesn’t look editable. Prefer it over `disabled` for values people need to copy.
`sm`, `default` and `lg` match the button heights, so an input and a button of the same size line up in a row.
